ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, including the $11M case and the Feeding Our Future scheme.
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How can the state prevent future cases of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale problem and spark meaningful change. By following the money and investigating the schemes, we can identify patterns and connections between entities and individuals.
